kebab_example: aliyun scsp create-ticket --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --template-id 546754 --category-id 10000 --creator-id 555555 --creator-type 4 --creator-name '刘测试' --member-id -1 --member-name '匿名会员' --from-info manual --priority 4 --carbon-copy 234432 --form-data '{"questionInfo":"自动化创建工单","CFQyYAPjKb":"开胶"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTicket

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID to generate this ID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance. You can view the instance ID in the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ticket template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tree category. If this parameter is not specified, the category of the ticket template is used
parameters.help_zh: 业务类目id（如果不传，取工单模板的类目）
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the creator (agent ID)
parameters.name: creator_id

parameters.help_en:
The role of the creator. Default value: 4. Valid values:

1: member
4: customer service representative
parameters.help_zh:
创建者角色（默认为4：客服），有以下枚举：
1：会员
4：客服
parameters.name: creator_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member. Set this parameter to -1 for an anonymous member
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en: The source from which the ticket is created
parameters.name: from_info

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the ticket. Valid values:

4: Normal.
0: Low.
1: Medium.
2: High.
3: Urgent
parameters.help_zh:
工单优先级，有以下枚举：
普通：4
低：0
中：1
高：2
紧急：3
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The account IDs of the carbon copy recipients. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 被抄送人账号id(多个抄送人用逗号分隔)
parameters.name: carbon_copy

parameters.help_en: The form configuration of the ticket template, in the format {"key":"value"}. key: the form field code. value: the record value. Example: {"questionInfo":"Automatically created ticket","CFQyYAPjKb":"Delamination"}
parameters.name: form_data
